paragraphs: R' Yochanan bar Shila. Mentioned in the Jerusalem Talmud, Shabbat, chapter 4, at the end of halakhah 1.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The source explicitly names the Jerusalem Talmud. פ״ד סה״א is read as chapter 4, end of halakhah 1, preserving the “end” element rather than substituting sugya. No named edition is independently checked.
The heading and original entry extent were recorded as provisional. The supplied name is retained; the abbreviated title remains R'.
